`FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY` may record the request state known at FLT publication,
but that state is historical provenance only.

`not_requested_at_FLT_publication` does not prohibit a later independently
requested SCI-NOI child. The later child owns its own request, applicability,
eligibility, realization, generation, and failure and still requires exact
compatible FLT boundary and profile state. No later request, child, or reverse
relation mutates FLT, and `FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY` never contains a future child
identity.
